newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs seen steady to higher, pork bellies mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs seen steady to higher, pork bellies mixed.

text.p: CME hog futures were expected to open steady to 0.200 cent higher while calls on pork bellies ranged from 0.100 cent lower to 0.100 higher, analysts said.
Steady to higher cash hog indications and improvement in pork cutout values fueled by firmer loin prices should prompt early strength in hog futures, analysts said.

Packers are showing good demand for cash hogs following the strength in cash loins. Also, harvesting is cutting hog marketings, especially in the prime areas of Iowa-South Minnesota, which will add to cash strength, they said.

Indications on pork bellies ranged mixed after Wednesday's wide price swings. The market will likely continue to trade between technical levels as it awaits fresh diection from cash markets, they said.
The fresh cash belly market continues to struggle but should attract user interest at these lower levels. The rate of hog slaughter will also influence cash markets and in turn futures, they said.
